services.name: Bay Fishing Trips
services.desc: > Vagabond is a Maine-built fishing vessel (MDI 45) that is offering 2 1/2 - 3 hour family friendly fishing trips for mackerel and pollock. Departing from the Bar Harbor Inn Pier in downtown Bar Harbor. We are limiting our number of guests to 30 (Vagabond is USCG inspected for 42) so you'll have more space! Captain Randy is an experienced Maine fisherman, fishing in Maine since he was 3! He enjoys helping guests learn to catch fish and he grew up on these waters. Vagabond is a fiberglass MDI 45' built right here on Mount Desert Island and has a long fishing history. All tackle is 2 1/2 - 3 Hour Trips onboard a Maine-built Fishing Boat. Family Friendly!

services.name: Schooner Sunset Sail-Joshua
services.desc: > Join us for a Sunset Sail and enjoy snacks and our beverage service while you cruise around beautiful Frenchman Bay. Schooner Joshua is a classic 72′ wooden sailing vessel built in 1995 and launched in 2002 by Captain Carol Bramblett. She became Alabama’s official tall ship in 2009 and has now traveled up the coast as we welcome her to Maine waters and Frenchman Bay to continue her sailing career. What's included? Beer, wine & soft drinks MAY - OCTOBER • All ages

services.name: Chrissy Lobster Sloop Cruises
services.desc: > Join us on the "Chrissy" for a truly memorable sail aboard one of the last original working Maine Lobster sloops. Perfect for your family, a group a six or a perfect romantic getaway for two! Beer and Wine🍷 will be available for sale $ on our Sunset Cruises ONLY and on Private Charters by request.
